answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A anchor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the willow of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. By the crystal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the unit of trust is a task, not an address.
